title: 🚫 Анти-реакция: отрицание to be
description: Сделай предложение отрицательным: вставь isn't, aren't, wasn't, weren't или am not.

items.sentence: He is a famous actor. → He ___ a famous actor.
They were at the cinema. → They ___ at the cinema.
The soup was spicy. → The soup ___ spicy.
I am an engineer. → I ___ an engineer.
The gadgets are cheap. → The gadgets ___ cheap.
You are 13 years old. → You ___ 13 years old.
The museum was open. → The museum ___ open.
It is a dangerous job. → It ___ a dangerous job.
The children were noisy. → The children ___ noisy.
My friend is a chatterbox. → My friend ___ a chatterbox.
The tickets were expensive. → The tickets ___ expensive.
The food is cold. → The food ___ cold.
I was late for school. → I ___ late for school.
